name: Samsung WD53 Laundry Combo Motor Winding Resistance
purpose: DD wash motor — any two of three terminals at connector. §4-4 3C cites 6.0 Ω @ 25°C.
failureModes: Open winding — 3C motor error
Unequal pairs — rotor/stator or harness fault
testingTips: Disconnect motor connector before ohms
Rule out 3E/3C1 overload before condemning motor
Smart Install manual check step 8 exercises dehydration spin

name: Samsung WD53 Wash Heater In-Circuit (A–B)
purpose: Wash heater terminals A and B at tub front per §4-4 HC TYPE 1.
failureModes: Open — replace heater
Good heater ohms but HC — check wash thermistor TYPE 2
testingTips: Disconnect power before accessing heater terminals
If TYPE 1 OK, replace wash thermistor at back of tub

name: Samsung WD53 Wash Heater Bench Resistance
purpose: Heater element removed from tub — 27.1 Ω (1900 W) or 26.2 Ω (2000 W) per §3.
failureModes: Open element — HC / no heat
Low ohms — shorted element
testingTips: Ensure heater seated in bracket on reassembly
§4-4 TYPE 1 in-circuit A–B expects 16.05 ± 0.65 Ω

name: Samsung WD53 Wash Thermistor (room temp)
purpose: Wash heater NTC at room temperature — ~12 kΩ per §3 thermistor checkpoint.
failureModes: Open/shorted NTC — TC1 / HC after heater ruled out
Frozen hose in winter — defrost before condemning sensor
testingTips: Measure at thermistor connector with leads attached
Compare after heater A–B passes TYPE 1 check

name: Samsung WD53 Door Switch (TYPE 1 pins 1–3)
purpose: Door switch TYPE 1 — resistance pins 1 and 3 approximately 175 Ω per §4-4 DC.
failureModes: Open switch — DC door error
120 V door feed — verify insulation before ohms
testingTips: Disconnect power — 120 V present on door circuit when energized
TYPE 2/3 lock slider pushed: pins 2–3 expect 60–90 Ω or 65–75 Ω

name: Samsung WD53 Door Lock Switch (TYPE 2/3 pins 2–3)
purpose: Door lock switch with slider pushed — TYPE 2: 60–90 Ω; TYPE 3: 65–75 Ω per §4-4 DC1.
failureModes: Out of range — replace door lock assembly
dC1 persists — check CAM, lever door, door sagging
testingTips: Push lock slider to simulate latched state
Inspect CAM and LEVER DOOR before condemning switch

name: Samsung WD53 Water Level Sensor Frequency (no load)
purpose: Pressure level sensor — approx. 25.5 kHz with no load on pink and orange wires per §4-4 1C.
failureModes: Out of band — replace water level sensor
Wrong material-code sensor installed — verify part number
testingTips: Connect sensor and harness before frequency check
Verify hose not folded, cut, or clogged

name: Samsung WD53 Drain / Circulation Pump Motor
purpose: Pump motor resistance — 330 Ω per §4-5 #7 (operation guarantee ±15% of rated 220 V).
failureModes: Open pump — 5C drain error
Impeller damaged — pump runs but does not drain
testingTips: Clear bellows of foreign material before condemning pump
Rule out winter freeze in drain hose

name: Samsung WD53 Duct / Discharge Thermistor
purpose: DUCT and DISCHARGE thermistor — 50 kΩ ± 7% @ 25°C (2P pins 1–2) per §4-5 #1 / tC.
failureModes: Open/high resistance — tC code
Dirty condenser filter — clean before condemning sensor
testingTips: Clean case filter first when tC displays
Measure at connector with leads attached

name: Samsung WD53 EVA IN / EVA OUT Thermistor
purpose: Evaporator thermistors — 10 kΩ ± 3% @ 25°C (4P pins 1–2 / 3–4) per §4-5 #2 / HC.
failureModes: Out of range — TC7/TC8 or compressor overheat HC
Connector loose — recheck harness before replace
testingTips: Measure EVA IN and EVA OUT separately
If HC with good ohms, enter line test mode per manual

name: Samsung WD53 Compressor Top Thermistor
purpose: Compressor top thermistor — 200 kΩ ± 3% @ 25°C (2P pins 1–2) per §4-5 #3 / TCA.
failureModes: Open/shorted — TCA fault
Compressor overheating — verify fan and condenser airflow
testingTips: Check inverter fan operation with 12 V bench test per §4-5 #8–9
Inspect compressor harness terminals for damage

name: Samsung WD53 Dry Heater Thermistor
purpose: Dry heater thermistor — 238.23 kΩ ± 7.5% @ 25°C (4P pins 1–4) per §4-5 #4 / TCB.
failureModes: Out of range — TCB fault
Heater thermistor open — dry heat path disabled
testingTips: Also 3.16 kΩ ± 3% @ 150°C when hot — room temp check first
Verify connector seated on heat pump module

name: Samsung WD53 Heat-Pump Dry Heater Element
purpose: Dry heater element — 35.6–39.4 Ω at 3P pins 1–3 per §4-5 #5.
failureModes: Open element — poor dry performance
Shorted element — thermal protection trip
testingTips: Disconnect power before measuring at heat pump module
Pair with dry heater thermistor (TCB) when heat fault suspected
